title: Crying Freeman
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yo Hinomura, a Japanese potter, is abducted by the 108 Dragons, a Chinese criminal society, and hypnotically conditioned into an assassin who weeps for each victim (Dark Horse blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates; ANN column). Emu Hino, a painter who witnesses a killing, falls in love with him and is accepted as his wife; he later becomes the society's leader, and the rest is a run of globe-trotting assassination jobs (ANN). A 1986 Kazuo Koike and Ryoichi Ikegami seinen thriller for adult readers.
life_message: It treats love and becoming powerful enough to be free as the goal of life (ANN column's reading).

content.note: Assassinations, a poison-gas massacre and an arena fight to the death (ANN); MangaUpdates Violence, Mass Murder/s, Serial Killer/s.
Paranoid spy-thriller tone with realistic-looking killings (ANN); Psychopath/s, Kidnapping/s (MangaUpdates).
Frequent explicit sex between adults with genitals censored; ANN calls it 'a shameless male fantasy'. MangaUpdates Adult genre, Borderline H, Rape; MangaDex erotica.
Crime-thriller dialogue; not described in sources (to verify).
MangaUpdates lists Alcohol; hypnotic conditioning rather than drugs.
Hero conditioned to kill against his will; tears of remorse (blurb).
The handsome, wealthy hitman is the reader's fantasy figure (ANN); Antihero tag (MangaUpdates).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Disputes settled by assassination and duels to the death (ANN column).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Freedom comes from becoming the most powerful, inside a criminal order (ANN).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty to the 108 Dragons 'family' above any law (blurb; ANN).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Masters command; Freeman rises to lead the society (ANN).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Triad rituals and tattoos alongside modern spy-thriller settings.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Constant danger; pleasure and love pursued between missions (ANN).

folkways.japan: It reflects 1980s Japanese gekiga, where Koike's adult thrillers paired stoic male heroes with criminal-family loyalty; the triad setting draws on Chinese diaspora crime-fiction tropes.

delivery.evidence: ANN calls it pulpy 'imaginative porn' with quick reversals; no moralizing described.

personified.ideology: freedom by becoming the most powerful (ANN's Ayn Rand comparison)

delivery.note: Sources describe it as a wish-fulfilment action story rather than one that argues a case.

winners_losers: Freeman and Emu win and rise to lead the society; rivals and targets lose. The hitman's power and charisma get the story's sympathy (ANN).
